WITH winner_tallies AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM manager_award ma
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
), shares AS (
    SELECT throws, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM winner_tallies
), above_average AS (
    SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;
